```{r define-parameters-metaecos-biomass}

# --- DEFINE PARAMETERS --- #

response_variable_selected = "bioarea_mm2_per_ml"
```

```{r plot-original-data-one-size-per-plot-metaeecos-biomass, fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ONE PLOT PER ECOSYSTEM SIZE --- #

plot.metaecos.sizes.one.by.one.means(ds_metaecosystems,
                                     response_variable_selected,
                                     light_colour_metaecos,
                                     dark_colour_metaecos,
                                     y_upper_limit = 25)
```

<br>

```{r prepare-data-for-analysis-metaecos}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(system_nr,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point %in% time_points_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected)),
         connection == "connected" | 
          ecosystems_combined %in% unconnected_metaecosystems_selected) %>%
  mutate(conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")))
```

<details>
<summary>Filtered data</summary>
```{r plot-data-for-analysis-metaecos, fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

ggarrange(plot.metaecos.legend(data_for_analysis %>% 
                                 filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                              response_variable_selected),
          plot.metaecos.points(data_for_analysis %>% 
                                 filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) + 
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.metaecos.points(data_for_analysis %>% 
                                 filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                               response_variable_selected)  +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(data_for_analysis$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none") +
            ggtitle(relative_label),
          heights = c(0.25, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v")
```
</details>

```{r create-model-metaecos}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(size = ecosystem_size_ml,
         dis_per = disturbance_percentage) %>%
  mutate(size = as.factor(size),
         day = as.factor(day))

# Create model 

model <- gls(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~ size * conn * dis_per, 
             weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day),  # Allow variance heterogeneity across days
             correlation = corAR1(form = ~ 1 | day),  # Model autocorrelation if needed
             data = data_for_analysis,
             control = glsControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 1000))
```

<summary>Model summary</summary>

# --- SHOW MODEL SUMMARY --- #

print(summary(model), digits = 3)
```
</details>

```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Model contrasts coding</summary>
```{r code-model-contrasts-metaecos}

# --- CODE MODEL CONSTRASTS --- #

# Estimate marginal means (least-squares means)

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * dis_per * size,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         bias.adj = TRUE,
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 

emmeans_output

# Give a name for each level which you want to compare

uncon_decr_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,15)) 
con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,14)) 
uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,13)) 
con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,12)) 
uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,11)) 
con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,10)) 
uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,9)) 
con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,8)) 
uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,7))
con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,6))
uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,5))
con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,4))
uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,3))
con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,2))
uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,1))
con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1)

# Compute the contrasts

n_of_digits = 3
contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("6.43 ml no interact" = con_fix_6_43 - uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "6.43 ml with interact" = con_decr_6_43 - uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_9 - uncon_fix_9,
                                   "9.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_9 - uncon_decr_9,
                                   "15.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_15 - uncon_fix_15,
                                   "15.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_15 - uncon_decr_15,
                                   "45.00 ml no interact" = con_fix_45 - uncon_fix_45,
                                   "45.00 ml with interact" = con_decr_45 - uncon_decr_45)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)
```
</details>

```{r show-model-contrasts}

# --- SHOW MODEL CONTRASTS --- #

contrasts
```
